# ADR-0008 — NEXUS-assigned Claude session IDs and session state machine

Status: Accepted (2026-11-04)

## Decision
* A new Claude session is launched with `--session-id <uuid v4>` generated by NEXUS and stored before spawn.
  No hook or transcript scanning is needed to learn the ID. Resume uses `--resume <uuid>` (never both flags).
* States: `starting → running → exited` (exit code recorded), `starting → failed` (spawn error recorded),
  `starting|running → interrupted` (found at app start with no live PTY in this process).
* A conversation is **resumable** when a transcript `<config dir>/projects/*/<uuid>.jsonl` exists — a glob,
  so the undocumented directory-name encoding does not matter. Transcript contents are never parsed here.
* Resume creates a new session row (`resumed_from` → previous row) with the same `claude_session_id`,
  profile and cwd, and a freshly built LaunchSpec (all session-scoped flags re-passed).
* Stop sends Ctrl-C to the PTY; "Force stop" (explicit confirmation) terminates the child. NEXUS never
  kills processes it did not start.
* Phase 2: reconcile with `claude agents --json` to detect conversations that are live in another terminal.

## Consequences
* A session that exits before any message shows "no conversation recorded" instead of a broken Resume.
* Session metadata survives crashes; live PTYs do not, and the UI says exactly that.
